KPI.desc: This KPI shows the residual Block Error Ratio (BLER) for PDSCH. Residual BLER is defined as the ratio between the number of failed transmissions after the MAX HARQ retransmission reached and the number of packets to transmit, that is, the 1st HARQ transmissions.In real-time monitoring, the HARQ feedback might be received in a different measurement period than the initial transmission. For that reason, the initial transmissions in the formula are calculated as the successful transmissions plus the unsuccessful transmissions.HARQ feedback DTX is considered as unsuccessful.

KPI.name: 5G Average delay DL in CU-UP per cell
KPI.lformula: Sum of (time when sending a PDCP SDU to the gNB-DU at the egress PDCP layer on F1-U/Xn-U, minus time of arrival of the same packet at NG-U ingress IP termination) / (total number of PDCP SDUs arriving at NG-U ingress IP termination)
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) PDCP SDU delay on the downlink within the gNB-CU-UP per cell, for all PDCP packets.

KPI.name: 5G Average PDCP re-ordering delay in the UL per cell
KPI.lformula: Sum of (time when sending a PDCP SDU to the core at the egress PDCP layer on NG-U IP termination, minus time of arrival of the same packet at F1-U/Xn-U ingress) / (total number of PDCP SDUs leaving the NG-U egress)
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) PDCP re-ordering delay on the uplink within the gNB-CU-UP per cell.

KPI.name: 5G Average DL scheduling delay in MAC with UE in DRX with active time of DRX Cycle per cell
KPI.lformula: sum of DL initial scheduling delay when UE is in DRX with active time of DRX Cycle / number of samples
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) MAC scheduling delay in the downlink within L2-PS while the UE monitors the PDCCH. The UE monitors the PDCCH if it is configured without DRX or when it is configured with DRX and the DRX Cycle is within active time. DRX Cycle consists of active and sleep time, where active time means that UE monitors PDCCH, while sleep time means that UE neither performs any monitoring on PDCCH nor any reporting on PUCCH. DRX inactive phase is when UE monitors PDCCH and is equal to active time of DRX Cycle.

KPI.name: 5G Average DL scheduling delay in MAC with UE in DRX with inactive time of DRX Cycle per cell
KPI.lformula: sum of DL initial scheduling delay when UE is in DRX with inactive time of DRX Cycle / number of samples
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) MAC scheduling delay in the downlink within L2-PS when UE is configured with DRX and when the DRX Cycle is within sleep time (data are pending during that time). DRX Cycle consists of active and sleep time, where active time means that UE monitors PDCCH, while sleep time means that UE neither performs any monitoring on PDCCH nor any reporting on PUCCH. DRX active phase is when UE does not monitor PDCCH and is equal to sleep/inactive time of DRX Cycle.

KPI.name: 5G Average air-interface UM RLC SDU delay in DL per cell
KPI.lformula: sum of (delay DL air-interface for UM RLC per cell) / (total number of RLC SDUs transmitted to UE successfully)
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) time it takes for RLC SDU packet to travel from DU to the UE and back from the UE to DU, in the downlink direction for UM RLC per cell. The exact time span is measured as difference between:- RLC SDU packet arrives in MAC layer and- the reception of HARQ ACK for UM mode for the corresponding RLC SDU packet at air interface.

KPI.name: 5G Average gNB-DU AM RLC SDU delay in DL per cell
KPI.lformula: sum of (AM RLC SDU DL delay in DU) / (Number of transmitted AM RLC SDUs in DL towards UE)
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) time it takes for AM RLC SDU packet to travel from gNB-DU to UE, per cell.The exact time span is measured as difference between:- AM RLC SDU arrives in MAC layer and- RLC ACK for the last part of the AM RLC SDU is received in the RLC layer.

KPI.name: 5G Average gNB-DU RLC SDU delay in DL per cell
KPI.lformula: sum of (RLC SDU DL delay in DU) / (Number of transmitted RLC SDUs in DL from RLC to MAC)
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) time it takes for RLC SDU packet to travel from RLC to MAC, per cell.The exact time span is measured as difference between:- the RLC SDU is received in the RLC layer and - the corresponding RLC SDU is sent to MAC layer.

KPI.name: 5G Average gNB-DU burst RLC SDU delay in DL per cell
KPI.lformula: sum of (INIT RLC SDU in burst DL IP latency in DU) / (Number of init RLC SDU in burst transmitted)
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) time it takes for Initial RLC SDU packet in a burst to travel from gNB-DU to UE, per cell.The exact time span is measured as difference between:- the RLC SDU is received at DU and - the first RLC SDU transmitted on the air interface.

KPI.name: 5G Average GTP-U packet delay in DL over F1-U per cell
KPI.lformula: sum of (DL GTP packet delay over F1-U) / (Number of DL GTP packets)
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) time it takes for GTP-U packet in DL to travel over F1-U interface, per cell. The exact time span is divided by two and is measured as a difference between:- sending the GTP-U packet to the gNB-DU at the GTP ingress termination (sending the PDCP packet from PDCP - DUD),- receiving feedback from the gNB-DU at the egress GTP termination (feedback receiving point at the PDCP SN - DDDS),with exclusion of processing time in gNB-DU.

KPI.name: 5G Average air-interface MAC SDU delay in UL per cell
KPI.lformula: sum of (delay UL air-interface for MAC SDU per cell) / (total number of UL MAC SDUs is sent to RLC)
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) time it takes for MAC SDU packet to travel from the UE to the DU from the point of time when UL grant is assigned, per cell. The exact time span is measured as difference between:- the UL MAC SDU is scheduled in MAC layer as per the scheduling grant sent to UE and- the UL MAC SDU is successfully sent to RLC.

KPI.name: 5G Average gNB-DU RLC SDU delay in UL per cell
KPI.lformula: sum of (RLC SDU UL delay in DU) / (Number of transmitted UL RLC SDU)
KPI.desc: This KPI provides the average (arithmetic mean) time it takes for RLC SDU packet to travel from RLC to PDCP, per cell.The exact time span is measured as difference between:- the RLC PDU being received by the RLC layer and - the corresponding RLC SDU is sent to PDCP layer in CU.

KPI.name: 5G Average value of scheduled MIMO layers per PRB in the UL
KPI.lformula: 5G Avg value of scheduled MIMO layers per PRB UL =Num of all scheduled layers for all used PRBs for UL MIMO /Num of all used PRBs for UL MIMO
KPI.nformula: (Sum(1* PRB_UL_SU_MIMO_1LAYER +2* (PRB_UL_SU_MIMO_2LAYER + PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_2LAYER) +3* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_3LAYER +4* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_4LAYER +5* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_5LAYER +6* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_6LAYER +7* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_7LAYER +8* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_8LAYER)/Sum(PRB_UL_SU_MIMO_1LAYER +PRB_UL_SU_MIMO_2LAYER +PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_2LAYER +PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_3LAYER +PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_4LAYER +PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_5LAYER +PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_6LAYER +PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_7LAYER +PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_8LAYER))
KPI.desc: This KPI shows the average value of scheduled MIMO layers per PRB in the UL

KPI.name: 5G Average number of UEs per UL PRB (MU-MIMO)
KPI.lformula: Number PRBs used by UEs (with pairing PRBs can be used several times) / number PRBs used
KPI.nformula: (Sum(1* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_NOPAIR_UE+ 2* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_2PAIR_UE+ 3* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_3PAIR_UE+ 4* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_4PAIR_UE+ 5* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_5PAIR_UE+ 6* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_6PAIR_UE+ 7* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_7PAIR_UE+ 8* PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_8PAIR_UE)/Sum(PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_NOPAIR_UE+ PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_2PAIR_UE+ PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_3PAIR_UE+ PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_4PAIR_UE+ PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_5PAIR_UE+ PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_6PAIR_UE+ PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_7PAIR_UE+ PRB_UL_MU_MIMO_8PAIR_UE))
KPI.desc: This KPI calculated the average number of UEs per UL PRB.

KPI.name: 5G DL PDCP SDU discard ratio per BTS
KPI.lformula: % of discarded PDCP SDU packets = 100* discarded PDCP SDU packets due to different reasons / (all received PDCP SDU packets in gNB)
KPI.desc: This KPI provides DL PDCP SDU discard ratio per BTS for all QoS group services, it includes both SA and NSA traffic (routed through LTE and NR legs).
